name: crm-workspace-shell
description: Modern CRM and relational data workspace shell featuring module sidebar, top record identifier bar, secondary filter/view switcher toolbar, blank data viewport, and slide-out record inspector side panel.

visual_references.name: Twenty CRM
visual_references.purpose: relational record layout with module sidebar, filter toolbar, and slide-out side panel

visual_references.name: Salesforce
visual_references.purpose: compact business record manager with inspector drawer and secondary filter bar

design_constraints: No hardcoded CRM schemas, lead data, or mock contacts
Empty main viewport container by default

source_provenance.neutralization_summary: Extracted modern CRM workspace shell from Twenty front-end module architecture. Replaced Linaria styled-components, Jotai atoms, and Lingui i18n with clean props and standard semantic tokens.
